title: Red Dwarf Universe
description: Set Blocks to build your own Red Dwarf Scenes/Sets
body:
![Shows all blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8aeffa50e897eb104941ff107428438b026e0fd3.png)

![shields.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-blue) | ![shields.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/Forger-True-green?style=flat&logo=curseforge) | ![shields.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForger-True-green?style=flat&logo=curseforge) 

![shields.io](https://img.shields.io/twitter/follow/drblockheadmc?style=social) ![shields.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/Items/Blocks-71-8A2BE2)

 

The Minecraft mod that transports you into the wacky world of Red Dwarf, the beloved UK sitcom by BBC. Step into the shoes of your favorite characters - whether you're the laid-back Lister, the uptight Rimmer, the flamboyant Cat, or the ever-helpful Kryten. Unleash your creativity and build elaborate sets, construct sprawling spaceships, and role-play iconic scenes from the show like never before. Explore the cosmos, encounter quirky aliens, and engage in hilarious misadventures - all while having the power to shape your own destiny. So, what are you waiting for? Dive into the Red Dwarf Universe, have a blast, and if things get too crazy, just remember - smeg off and enjoy the ride!

 

![shields.io](https://i.imgur.com/MuIQRIl.png)

We hope to provide you set props and blocks so you can create your iconic scenes within the RDU we give you the blocks so you are able to create the scenes with your own flair.

 

![shields.io](https://i.imgur.com/lHhFPmL.png)

Do we have recipes? well yes, please use a recipe viewing mod like JEI, this will make it much easier and faster to see any recipes as we are still working on this mod and recipes might change over time or we just don't have time to document ever recipe for use, this way you still get the recipes you need and we can keep making the sets you enjoy.

I will add recipes to the image section in the future.

![shields.io](https://i.imgur.com/qXt8Ao2.png)

Red Dwarf Universe is a fan-created Minecraft mod inspired by the UK sitcom Red Dwarf by BBC. We have developed this mod as an expression of our love and admiration for the original show. All textures, models, and content are our own creations, and no copyrighted material from BBC has been used. We do not claim ownership of any rights to the Red Dwarf name or characters. This mod is unofficial and not affiliated with BBC. Enjoy the nostalgia and have a fantastic time exploring the Red Dwarf Universe! Happy gaming!
